custom_fields.description: Auto-added contingency note, printed whenever any commitment clause is present.
custom_fields.label: Commitment Note
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_commitment_note

custom_fields.description: Set Level + Total Fixed Pay, then use 'Compute Compensation Breakup'. The Earnings table below is filled automatically.
custom_fields.label: Compensation Breakup (Auto by Grade)
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_comp_input_section

custom_fields.description: Salary Structure = existing / manual flow (default, unchanged). Auto by Grade = auto-compute the full salary breakup from Level + Total Fixed Pay.
custom_fields.label: Compensation Method
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_compensation_method

custom_fields.description: Total Fixed Pay + Incentive + Location Allowance.
custom_fields.label: CTC (Total)
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_ctc

custom_fields.description: Employment type, auto-filled from the Job Applicant.
custom_fields.label: Employment Type
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_employment_type

custom_fields.description: Requisition this offer draws its headcount from, resolved via the candidate's Job Opening. Fixed and Variable Pay are fetched from it.
custom_fields.label: Job Requisition
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_job_requisition

custom_fields.description: Defaults from the Location master; editable per offer. Added on top of Total Fixed Pay for CTC.
custom_fields.label: Location Allowance
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_location_allowance

custom_fields.description: Offer letter template used to render / preview this offer.
custom_fields.label: Offer Letter Template
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_offer_letter_template

custom_fields.description: Human-readable form of the claimed position (number, location, type).
custom_fields.label: Position
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_position_label

custom_fields.description: The specific position on the requisition this offer consumes. Chosen with the Select Position dialog; the position moves to Filled while this offer is active.
custom_fields.label: Requisition Position
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_requisition_position

custom_fields.description: Compute percentage components on a Monthly or Annual basis. Monthly: Basic = Base, CTC = annual CTC ÷ 12. Annual: Basic = Base × 12, CTC = annual CTC.
custom_fields.label: Salary Component Period
custom_fields.name: Job Offer-custom_salary_period
